responses.body:

Thank you for sharing the latest AI developments in your recent newsletter. I found the updates on OpenAI's Codex-Spark, Meta's smart glasses sales, and IBM's hiring strategy particularly insightful.

The focus on real-time coding experience with Codex-Spark and the growing consumer adoption of AI wearables are especially noteworthy trends. I appreciate you keeping me informed about these industry developments.
